MOVE_WILD_CHARGE.name: MOVE_WILD_CHARGE

MOVE_ICE_FANG.name: MOVE_ICE_FANG

MOVE_THUNDER_FANG.name: MOVE_THUNDER_FANG

MOVE_FLARE_BLITZ.name: MOVE_FLARE_BLITZ

MOVE_INFERNO.name: MOVE_INFERNO

MOVE_CIRCLE_THROW.name: MOVE_CIRCLE_THROW

MOVE_SCALD.name: MOVE_SCALD

MOVE_FAIRY_WIND.name: MOVE_FAIRY_WIND

description: The user faints, but will fully heal the Pokémon taking its place.

MOVE_BOOMBURST.name: MOVE_BOOMBURST

MOVE_INCINERATE.name: MOVE_INCINERATE

MOVE_WORRY_SEED.name: MOVE_WORRY_SEED

MOVE_GASTRO_ACID.name: MOVE_GASTRO_ACID

MOVE_GEOMANCY.name: MOVE_GEOMANCY

MOVE_ROTOTILLER.name: MOVE_ROTOTILLER

MOVE_SHIFT_GEAR.name: MOVE_SHIFT_GEAR

MOVE_STICKY_WEB.name: MOVE_STICKY_WEB

MOVE_STORED_POWER.name: MOVE_STORED_POWER

MOVE_ASSURANCE.name: MOVE_ASSURANCE

MOVE_NECROMANCY.name: MOVE_NECROMANCY

MOVE_ERROR_WAVE.name: MOVE_ERROR_WAVE

MOVE_CRYSTAL_DUST.name: MOVE_CRYSTAL_DUST

MOVE_PETAL_STORM.name: MOVE_PETAL_STORM

MOVE_SILENT_WAVE.name: MOVE_SILENT_WAVE

MOVE_SILENT_ARROW.name: MOVE_SILENT_ARROW

MOVE_HEAT_RAGE.name: MOVE_HEAT_RAGE

MOVE_TEMPEST.name: MOVE_TEMPEST

MOVE_METAL_BALL.name: MOVE_METAL_BALL
